question: On 16 May 2025, the Supreme Court struck down government provisions that allowed what type of environmental clearance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Retrospective environmental clearances**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **16 May 2025**, the **Supreme Court** of India delivered a significant verdict striking down the government provisions that allowed for **Retrospective environmental clearances**.
 
• **Retrospective clearances**, often referred to as **ex post facto** approvals, allowed industrial and developmental projects to begin operations without obtaining prior mandatory environmental permissions, seeking regularisation at a later stage.
 
• The **Apex Court** observed that allowing such clearances is fundamentally contrary to the **Precautionary Principle** and the core objectives of the **Environment (Protection) Act, 1986**.
 
• The ruling emphasized that environmental impact must be assessed **before** the commencement of any activity to prevent irreversible damage to the **ecosystem** and biodiversity.
